messages:
sara_ae: Heads-up - prospect (tier-1 financial) wants an air-gapped POC. Requirements: quarterly major upgrades, monthly security deltas, signed artifacts, SBOM, and on-prem key provisioning via courier USB. Asking if we can support this flow and any blockers.

luke_se: Short: doable but with caveats. We can produce signed, quantized bundles and emit binary diff patches. Deltas for quantized weights are supported but currently considered experimental for non-trivial chunk layouts. Need acceptance of patch client on their side.

hana_compliance: From compliance POV: must provide SBOM per bundle, detached signature (PKCS#7 or similar), reproducible build hashes, and attestations for each applied patch. Also need a documented key provisioning playbook (USB courier + MD5/sha256 checksum verification, chain-of-custody).

ben_ops: Ops notes: our standard installer assumes systemd. If customer runs a hardened RHEL with systemd off, we'll need ~10 business days to add a sysv/openrc-compatible installer and smoke-test images. Also we only certify kernels >= 4.18; older kernels are unsupported.

sara_ae: They will not accept a heavy monthly downtime. They asked if deltas require a reboot or service restart.

luke_se: Deltas normally touch model files and runtime libs. Most deltas can apply without a full reboot, but a short process restart is typical (2-5s). We'll document best-effort zero-downtime steps but cannot guarantee for all patches.

hana_compliance: Contract asks: include vulnerability SLA window (e.g., 30/90/365 depending on severity), signed attestation for each patch, and option for offline forensic logs. Also specify supported delivery channels (SFTP w/ MFA, signed USB courier).

ben_ops: Delivery format proposal: base bundle = signed tar.xz (quantized shards + runtime) + SBOM.json + manifest.json with bundle-hash. Delta packs = signed patch.tar.xz referencing base-hash. Delta client will refuse if base-hash mismatch. Example verify/apply commands for docs: 

```
# verify bundle
./rw-verify --artifact redwood-bundle-v1.tar.xz --sig redwood-bundle-v1.tar.xz.sig --pubkey bank-root.pem
# list sbom
jq . sbom.json
# apply delta
./rw-delta apply --patch delta-2026-06.tar.xz --base-hash 9a1b2c3d
```

sara_ae: Pricing + delivery: they asked if air-gap + custom USB courier + monthly deltas adds cost. What's the recommended commercial stance?

luke_se: Recommend: base private license + one-time packaging/airgap fee (artifact signing, USB image prep) + quarterly bundle production fee if we handle build+sign vs customer self-host. Then a monthly patch support retainer if we produce delta packs. Ballpark: 8-12% uplift on private list, but comms should set exact numbers.

hana_compliance: Also note: if we hold signing keys on their behalf (HSM-backed), there are compliance implications. Prefer customer-managed keys whenever possible. If customer requests our HSM signing, add indemnity language and additional SOC/PCI evidence.

ben_ops: POC plan suggestion: 1) exchange keys & establish courier SOP, 2) ship initial quantized bundle (smoke test prompts + perf check), 3) produce a small delta (config + patch) and validate apply flow, 4) simulate a rollback. POC target timeline: 3 weeks if systemd present, 5+ weeks if non-systemd work required.

sara_ae: Customer also asked about delta size expectations. Can you provide roughs for a 13B model quantized to 4-bit?

luke_se: Rough numbers: base quantized bundle ~12-14GB depending on tokenizer & sharding. Small config/model tokenizer patches often <50MB. Weight diffs vary wildly; benchmark example: a tiny finetune + prompt-tuning deltas can be <200MB, but weight-only deltas for large internal regens can be multiple GBs. We'll set expectation: usually much smaller than full bundle, but not guaranteed.

hana_compliance: For SRA/security questionnaire answers I'll include sample attestation logs and a template clause for key custody. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

artifact-bot: build/9920: signed bundle redwood-quant-v1.tar.xz available at artifacts.internal/redwood/9920 (sha256: 9a1b2c3d...). CI: tests=green :package: 

sara_ae: Great. I'll summarize and ask for a commercial estimate + confirm whether customer will manage keys or want our HSM flow. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
